baseline_P: explicitly choose measured empirical conditional frequencies, not an optimality claim
batch_reduction: sum fixed token-weighted contributions; no row/batch/token-count renormalization
boundary_policy: exact rendered prefix and content, exact token prefix, offsets and raw-content decode
boundary_straddling_token_policy: reject; never silently include prompt or drop target bytes
control_Q: uniform two-class mass, not coverage prior r, Novelty, or utility evidence
domain: the five previously Qualified and assigned model trajectories; no new sampling
loss_normalization: sum target-token losses within each original trajectory / its total target tokens
materialization: one finite original trajectory pool with uniform within-state trajectory kernel
nonqualified_sessions: all M01 submissions excluded, including its admitted intermediate steps
original_request_messages: exact messages from the corresponding saved HTTP body_json
original_target: exact raw_public_json string from the corresponding original model submission
qualification_and_assignment: reuse frozen original authorities; no new validity or quotient computation
rejected_submissions: zero positive imitation loss; preserve all source references and feedback
row_order: original cohort registration order, then actual turn order
source_selection: one row for each actual admitted model submission in a Qualified session
target_mask_policy: only tokens wholly inside the exact original assistant content span
template_policy: the frozen local Student chat_template applied to actual messages and raw assistant content
token_coefficient: pi(state) * M(trajectory|state) / total supervised tokens in that trajectory
views_share: same text rows, row order, tokenizer, template, input_ids, labels, attention and target masks
